errors.what: First probe of sideways.mjs output looked empty for ~10 min
errors.why: it prints only at the end of the whole-catalogue run (8,679 pages); not an error, just no progress output

doc_friction.issue: Gives no progress output during a 10-15 minute whole-catalogue run, so an empty log is indistinguishable from a hung run. Fixed in this PR: a stderr progress line every 500 pages.
Says change-order-margin scrolls sideways at 768-900 px; the real range was 761-950 px and four other pages had the same defect, which a whole-catalogue sweep at one mid width found in one pass.

goal: Impressive sites: no page scrolls sideways at any common width
notes: Swept 8,679 built pages at 820 and 900 px with sideways.mjs: 5 and 4 overflowed (115-477 px at 820). All five fixed with minmax(0,1fr) tracks and inputs that fill their cells; each measured at 0 px overflow at 11 widths from 320 to 1,280. sideways.mjs now defaults to WIDTH=360,820 (resize in place; checked to give identical numbers to fresh loads on vendor-rate-break-even before the fix: +236 at 820, +156 at 900). Venture suites: change-order 107/107, contractor 56/56, cash-runway 76/76, vendor-rate 41/41, clothing-design-studio 654/654. Full catalogue at the new default 360,820 after the fixes: 820 clean; one real pre-existing failure at 360 (s3-storage-class-savings +67 px, an unbreakable CSV header in a label), fixed with <code> and re-measured 0 px at 320-1,280. sideways.mjs now names 'text in <el>' when no box sticks out. platform/pages tests: 1,544 pass, 0 fail, 15 skipped.

pricing.source: Anthropic pricing as cached in the Claude API skill (models table and per-model migration notes), 2026-10-06. Cache writes are 1.25x input (5-minute) and 2x input (1-hour); cache reads differ by model.

certainty.tokens: high: summed from the per-request `usage` the API returned, as the transcript recorded it, deduplicated by message id
certainty.model: high: the `model` field on each API response, not the configured model
certainty.api_equivalent_usd: medium: measured tokens x list prices in prompts/pricing.json (as_of stated); an equivalent, not a charge: these runs are billed under a subscription
certainty.time: medium: from transcript timestamps; model time is request-to-response, tool time is call-to-result, time waiting on a person is excluded from active time
certainty.human_equivalent: low: the agent's own estimate of how long a competent person would take, with its basis written down; never measured

not_counted: requests the harness makes outside the transcript (context compaction summaries, title generation, safety classifiers), if any
transcripts lost when a cloud session moved to a new container: only files present in this container are read, so a resumed session can undercount
